quarterly_data.signal: Glass packaging equipment and R&D per the half-year report: Philoptics says it produces Laser TGV (through-glass via) equipment and supplies laser singulation, maskless DI exposure, laser drilling and TGV AOI equipment to development and mass-production lines of major domestic and overseas semiconductor packaging customers (history: Laser TGV first shipped March 2024, Laser Singulation shipped March 2025, TGV AOI order May 2026). Listed R&D results include the TRONADA FX high-speed TGV system, next-generation ABF UV drilling, glass singulation for glass interposer substrates, a high-speed nonlinear-absorption TGV process for glass interposers, a TGV interposer integrating opto-chiplets for a CPO optical engine (2.5D optical packaging; the company says it is the first domestic application of a TGV interposer to a CPO optical-engine package), a 1.5 um-resolution laser-scan TGV system and a +/-3 um large-area laser-scanning TGV tool, plus an HD-class DI exposure tool (overlay 4 um, fine line 6 um). R&D expense KRW 2,920,301K in H1 = 20.2% of separate revenue (9.1% in FY2025).
quarterly_data.figure: Laser TGV, singulation, DI exposure, drilling, TGV AOI equipment; TGV AOI order May 2026; R&D KRW 2,920,301K (20.2% of revenue)
